hear-no-dub.status.no_key: No subtitle source set up (Settings > Sources needs a SubDL or OpenSubtitles key)
hear-no-dub.status.found: %s results. Click one to use it
hear-no-dub.status.unsure: Couldn't tell which episode this is. Pick the right file below
hear-no-dub.picker.title: Hear No Dub: Subtitles
hear-no-dub.picker.nothing: Nothing is playing (start a video in your browser)
hear-no-dub.picker.unsupported: Media detection only works on Windows
hear-no-dub.picker.lines_hint: Pause right after a line is spoken, then click that line
hear-no-dub.picker.no_lines: No lines near this point in the video
hear-no-dub.position.title: Move subtitles
hear-no-dub.position.hint: Drag the caption, then press Done
hear-no-dub.config.title: Hear No Dub
hear-no-dub.config.enabled.desc: Same as the toggle key (J by default).
hear-no-dub.config.auto_search.desc: When a new video starts, search OpenSubtitles and load the best match automatically. Each new video uses one of your daily downloads; rewatching uses the cache.
hear-no-dub.config.toasts.desc: Small pop-ups when subtitles are found, missing or fail to load.
hear-no-dub.config.nudge.desc: How far one press of [ or ] moves the subtitles.
hear-no-dub.config.username.desc: Optional. Logging in raises the daily download limit.
hear-no-dub.config.move.desc: Drag the caption box to where you want it.
hear-no-dub.config.width.desc: Lines longer than this wrap. Up to 3 lines are shown.
hear-no-dub.status.found_from: %s results (%s). Click one to use it
hear-no-dub.config.sources.help: Hear No Dub searches every source that's switched on and has a key. SubDL is tried first because its free limits are much higher (thousands of searches, a few hundred downloads a day). OpenSubtitles gives about 20 downloads a day with a free account. Keys are stored in plain text in config/hear-no-dub.json.
hear-no-dub.config.group.subdl.desc: Free key: sign up at subdl.com, open your profile and click "Copy API Code".
hear-no-dub.config.use_subdl.desc: Search SubDL (the old Subscene library, strong on anime).
hear-no-dub.config.subdl_key.desc: From your subdl.com profile ("Copy API Code").
hear-no-dub.config.group.os.desc: Free account at opensubtitles.com. Create an API key under Profile > API consumers. Username and password are optional but raise the daily downloads from 5 to about 20.
hear-no-dub.config.group.jimaku.desc: Anime subtitle archive at jimaku.cc. Mostly Japanese files; by default only files that look English are shown. Free key on your jimaku.cc account page.
hear-no-dub.config.use_jimaku.desc: Search Jimaku too. Off by default because it's mostly Japanese.
hear-no-dub.config.jimaku_japanese.desc: Also list Jimaku's Japanese subtitles (for language learners).
hear-no-dub.config.scale.desc: Size of the HUD caption text.
hear-no-dub.config.opacity.desc: Darkness of the box behind the HUD caption.
hear-no-dub.config.anchor.desc: Follow my view: floats in front of you and glides after your view. New spot each line: every line spawns in front of you and stays there until it ends. Fixed in place: stays where you place it (press "Place 3D subtitles here").
hear-no-dub.config.world_distance.desc: How far in front of you the text floats (and where "place here" puts it).
hear-no-dub.config.world_height.desc: Up or down from eye level. Negative = lower.
hear-no-dub.config.world_opacity.desc: Darkness of the box behind 3D text (when the style has a box, and for speech bubbles).
hear-no-dub.config.world_see_through.des: Keep the 3D text visible even when a block is in the way.
hear-no-dub.msg.nothing_playing: Hear No Dub: no video to control
hear-no-dub.history.title: Recent lines (H to hide)
hear-no-dub.config.auto_pause.desc: Pause the video when you open the Esc menu and resume when you return to the game. Only resumes what the mod paused. Alt-tabbing doesn't pause.
hear-no-dub.config.screen_mode.desc: HUD: a caption you can move. Action bar: above the hotbar. Chat: each line posted once (only you see it). None: nothing on screen.
hear-no-dub.config.world_mode.desc: Floating: in front of you or fixed in place. Pop-in: each line pops up at a random spot in your view and moves with your camera. Speech bubble: above the mob you look at, or above you. Works together with the screen setting.
hear-no-dub.config.preset.desc: Movie: white with a black outline. Glow: soft halo. Box: text on a dark box. Retro: gold text on a brown box. Custom: use the settings below.
hear-no-dub.config.animation.desc: How lines appear and disappear, in every mode.
hear-no-dub.config.karaoke.desc: Reveal each line's words one by one over the time it's on screen.
hear-no-dub.config.next_preview.desc: Show the upcoming line faintly under the current one (HUD and Floating).
hear-no-dub.config.keep_formatting.desc: Use the italics/bold from the subtitle file (often thoughts, flashbacks, off-screen voices).
hear-no-dub.config.speaker_colors.desc: Give each named speaker their own color, when the file names them (.ass files, or "NAME:" lines).
hear-no-dub.config.group.custom.desc: Used when Style is set to Custom.
hear-no-dub.config.text_color.desc: Color of the subtitle text (speaker colors override it).
hear-no-dub.config.outline.desc: Draw an outline around the letters.
hear-no-dub.config.shadow.desc: Minecraft's drop shadow under the text.
hear-no-dub.config.glow.desc: A soft halo around the text.
hear-no-dub.config.box.desc: A box behind the text. Its opacity is set under Display (HUD) and 3D modes.
hear-no-dub.config.world.help: Pick a 3D mode under Display > In the world. Bind "Place 3D subtitles here" in Controls to move Floating text in front of you.
hear-no-dub.config.group.floating.desc: Text floating in front of you, or fixed where you place it.
hear-no-dub.config.group.popin.desc: Each line pops up at a random spot in your view and moves with your camera.
hear-no-dub.config.popin_distance.desc: How far away the lines appear.
hear-no-dub.config.popin_spread_x.desc: How far from the crosshair (sideways) lines can appear.
hear-no-dub.config.popin_spread_y.desc: How far from the crosshair (up and down) lines can appear.
hear-no-dub.config.group.bubble.desc: Lines float above someone's head in a bubble.
hear-no-dub.config.bubble_target.desc: Auto: whoever you're looking at right now, else you. Looked-at mob: picked when a line starts and kept for that line. Me: always above your head (see it in F5).
hear-no-dub.config.bubble_range.desc: How far away a mob can be to get the bubble.
hear-no-dub.config.world_follow_delay.de: Follow my view only: how long the text takes to catch up when you turn or walk. 0 = glued to your view.
hear-no-dub.config.per_line_random.desc: New spot each line only: spawn somewhere random in your view (uses the Pop-in spread) instead of straight ahead.
hear-no-dub.config.billboard.desc: Turn toward me: the text always points straight at you, even at the edge of your view. Turn toward me, stay vertical: turns left/right toward you but never leans back. Flat to screen: parallel to your screen (looks skewed at the edges). Flat to screen, copy tilt: like name tags.
hear-no-dub.config.third_person_bubble.d: When you switch to third person (F5), show speech bubbles instead of your normal 3D mode, and switch back in first person. Uses "Who's talking" below (Auto = the mob you look at, else you).
